rationale.A: ~2.3 km in mixed traffic: Lauttasaarentie, then Helsinginkatu, Vauhtitie, Veturitie and Pasilankatu at the Pasila end; 12 lights
rationale.B: Avoids Lauttasaarentie but has the same ~1.6 km in traffic on Vauhtitie/Veturitie/Pasilankatu; 11 lights
rationale.C: Baana, Linnunlaulu and the rail-side path, but 680 m in traffic on Lauttasaarentie; 5 lights
rationale.D: 680 m on Lauttasaarentie, then Baana, a Mannerheimintie-side track and Central Park; 8 lights
rationale.E: 680 m on Lauttasaarentie, then Baana and paths partly beside Helsinginkatu; 7 lights
rationale.F: No mixed traffic: Tallberginpuisto paths, Baana, Linnunlauluntie and the rail-side path; 4 lights; +2 min
rationale.G: Salmisaari shore and Lapinlahti paths to Baana, but 680 m on Lauttasaarentie; +4 min
rationale.H: Lauttasaarentie plus Mechelininkatu and Hietaniemi, several unsignalised Mechelininkatu crossings; 14 lights; +5 min

notes: Clear case: F removes all mixed traffic and 8 lights for +2 min. C and F share most of the route but differ on Lauttasaari (Lauttasaarentie in traffic vs park path), so I did not group them.
